title: Global Convergence and Reliable Stopping in a Safeguarded Modified Anderson--Björck Method
summary: The modified Anderson-Bjorck (modAB) method was first proposed in 2023 by Ganchovski and Traykov for solving nonlinear equations in structural mechanics. It was improved further in 2026 by introducing better switching criteria with account to function symmetry, and bisection fallback based on measuring the bracket reduction rate. Although the algorithm demonstrated superior performance across a great variety of functions, it lacked formal mathematical analysis and proof of convergence. In addition, some discrepancies were noted by L. Tomov in the latest version that need to be addressed:…
